mapper.update: /* updateCommonMpIvDlvryNoticePop */ MERGE INTO ICOMCOD1 A USING ( SELECT 'TRNOTICE' AS TYPE, #{st_user_id} AS CODE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND B.TYPE = A.TYPE AND B.CODE = A.CODE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TEXT1 = #{st_com_code} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TYPE, CODE, TEXT1, FLAG, ADD_DATE, TEXT5 ) VALUES ( 'TRNOTICE', #{st_user_id}, #{st_com_code}, 'Y', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') )
